description: This file contains unit tests for the Builder class in the Todaymade\Daux\Tree namespace, specifically testing directory and page creation, removal of sorting info, handling of filenames (including unicode), ignored files, and index front matter processing.

classes.name: BuilderTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class that tests various functionalities of the Builder class for directory/page creation and content handling within the Daux documentation project.

methods.name: providerRemoveSorting
methods.description: Provides test data for testing the removal of sorting information from filenames.

methods.name: testRemoveSorting
methods.description: Tests the static method removeSortingInformations for various filename scenarios.

methods.name: testGetOrCreateDirNew
methods.description: Tests creating a new directory node via getOrCreateDir.

methods.name: testGetOrCreateDirExisting
methods.description: Tests retrieving an existing directory node via getOrCreateDir.

methods.name: getStaticRoot
methods.description: Provides a static root object with defined configurations for use in multiple tests.

methods.name: providerCreatePage
methods.description: Provides test data for creating pages with different filenames, including unicode characters.

methods.name: testGetOrCreatePage
methods.description: Tests creation of page entries, verifying URL, URI, title, and correct parent association.

methods.name: testChangeUri
methods.description: Tests updating a page's URI and validating URL, URI, title, and directory entries are updated accordingly.

methods.name: testGetOrCreatePageAutoMarkdown
methods.description: Checks auto-detection and conversion of filenames to markdown pages.

methods.name: testGetOrCreateIndexPage
methods.description: Verifies creation of index pages with correct titles.

methods.name: testGetOrCreatePageExisting
methods.description: Ensures existing pages are correctly retrieved without duplication.

methods.name: testGetOrCreateRawPage
methods.description: Tests creation of raw content pages like JSON files.

methods.name: testUnicodeFilenames
methods.description: Verifies handling of filenames with unicode (e.g., Chinese characters).

methods.name: testIgnoredFiles
methods.description: Ensures files and folders configured to be ignored are not included in the tree.

methods.name: testIndexFrontMatter
methods.description: Checks if front matter in index.md files correctly updates the directory's title.
